propositions: Plan-review gate currently exempts bug tickets to bare PASS without substantive DET or LLM review, leaving bugs unreviewed.
FixedBench identifies over-action gap: proposed changes that add mechanisms without establishing necessity are not flagged by any plan-review criterion.
New advisory-only 'necessity' criterion must flag plans lacking motivation/reproduction while accepting well-motivated, no-op, and docs-only outcomes as single-turn plan-text judgments.
Bug review tier must run DET floor + necessity probe (advisory only, never blocking) instead of short-circuiting to exempt-PASS, restoring substantive review to bugs.
Necessity criterion must NOT suppress ticket_type=bug (unlike F1/F4/A1/G7) to apply to bugs; must register in CANONICAL_LLM to avoid CI orphan-check failure.
Effectiveness monitoring flows through standing recorder with zero additional wiring; advisory-to-blocking promotion remains dogfood-gated on per-criterion effectiveness metrics.
